_comment: Evidence from a real `claude -p --plugin-dir` run. Regenerate with `node test/qa-harness-full-live.js --layer hooks --record` whenever hooks.json changes. This is verified evidence re-verified on change, NOT a live session run by CI.

unverifiedEvents.ConfigChange: writing .claude/settings.json mid-session did not register as a settings change in -p mode
unverifiedEvents.CwdChanged: cd inside a Bash tool call does not change the SESSION working directory
unverifiedEvents.Notification: non-interactive -p raises neither a permission prompt nor an idle prompt
unverifiedEvents.PermissionRequest: non-interactive -p has no permission prompt surface, in any permission mode
unverifiedEvents.PostCompact: follows PreCompact, which the probe session did not reach
unverifiedEvents.PostToolUseFailure: the failing command was refused or handled before the tool itself reported failure
unverifiedEvents.PreCompact: the probe session did not reach the compaction threshold even under --autocompact 100k
unverifiedEvents.StopFailure: requires a real API-level failure (rate limit, overload, billing) that cannot be manufactured
unverifiedEvents.TaskCompleted: follows TaskCreated, which a subagent dispatch does not produce
unverifiedEvents.TaskCreated: the Task tool dispatching a subagent does not create a TRACKED task; needs TaskCreate
unverifiedEvents.TeammateIdle: requires Agent Teams with a teammate that goes idle; a single subagent dispatch never idles
unverifiedEvents.UserPromptExpansion: a slash command named inside a -p prompt is not expanded as a command; needs an interactive expansion
